data.action: 跪坐丝绒软垫双臂被宝蓝丝带轻绕，双颊潮红含泪喘息
data.animaCaption: Kneeling nude on velvet cushions wearing only her crescent hair ornament, white thigh-highs, and blue silk ribbons draped across her arms, she gazes at the viewer with teary eyes and a deep blush.
data.description: 月光如水倾泻的私密观星寝阁软垫上，尤诺神装尽褪，仅戴新月发冠、白丝过膝袜与缠绕臂间的宝蓝星纱丝带，雪白双峰在月光下泛起红晕。
data.lighting: 清冷月光直照雪白肌肤与蓝丝带幽光
data.location: 月轮观星塔私密神官寝阁
data.nsfwProse: Completely unclothed save for her white thigh-high stockings and trailing blue ribbons, she parts her knees on the cushions with tear-brimmed eyes and breathless vulnerability.
data.promptProse: Having shed her oracle vestments in the moonlit chamber, Iuno kneels bare on velvet cushions wearing only her silver crescent tiara, white thigh-highs, and trailing blue silk ribbons.
data.title: 尤诺 · 月光祭坛榻上褪去神装仅留星月丝带与白丝
